verses.transcription: yaa mukrimad dayfi jaaran kaana aw zaaraa
yaa maahiyan han khadiimin qablu aw zaaraa

verses.text: نَادَاكَ فِى الْبَرِّ بَعْدَ الْبَحْرِ خَادِمُكُمْ
verses.transcription: naadaaka fil barri bahdal bahri khaadimukum
wal yawma qudtta lahu bil laahi makhtaaraa
akramtahu biqiraa amrin wa takrimatin
fahaaza han jumlatil aswaa-i astaaraa

verses.text: خَلَّيْتَهُ عَنْ سِوَى الرِّضْوَانِ قَبْلُ كَمَا
verses.transcription: khallaytahu han siwar ridwaani qablu kamaa
hallaytahu bimunad daarayni mibraaraa
bikan tahaa sayhruhu lil laahi murtadiyan
hankum wa qad haaza anwaaran wa asraaraa
ammantahu min shaqaa-in faa-izan abadan
khillan wa hibban lakum laa yadkhulun naaraa

verses.text: نَالَ الْمُنَى مَعْ صَفَا مَا بَعْدَهُ كَدَرٌ
verses.transcription: naalal munaa mah safaa maa bahdahu kadarun

verses.text: مِنْ مُشْتَرٍ مِّنْهُ عِنْدَ الْبَحْرِ دِينَارَا
verses.transcription: min mushtarin minhu hindal bahri diinaaraa

verses.text: مِنْهُ اشْتَرَى اللَّهُ كَحْ حَيْثُ انْتَحَتْ أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: minhush taral lahu kah haysun tahat abadan

verses.text: كَمَا لَهُ قَادَ مَا يَهْوَاهُ أَوْطَارَا
verses.transcription: kamaa lahu qaada maa yahwaahu aw taaraa
wallal lahiinu biya-sin minhu munsarifan

verses.text: وَكُلُّ مَا فِيهِ ضُرٌّ دَبَّ أَوْطَارَا
verses.transcription: wa kullu maa fiihi durrun dabba aw taaraa
lighayrihi yantahii ibliisu fii abadin
kafaahu rabbuka takhmiinan wa akdaaraa
antan nabiyyur rasuulul mustafaa halaman

verses.text: صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ الَّذِى التَّفْضِيلُ قَدْ دَّارَا
verses.transcription: sallaa halaykal lazii tafdiilu qad daaraa
innii lajuuruka yaa khayral waraa abadan

verses.text: عَلَيْكَ سَلَّمَ مَنْ كُلِّى لَهُ صَارَا
verses.transcription: halayka sallama man kullii lahu saaraa

verses.text: صَلَّى وَسَلَّمَ بَاقٍ لَّا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
verses.transcription: sallaa wa sallama baaqin laa shariika lahu

verses.text: عَلَيْكَ يَامَنْ بِهِ لِى قُدْتَّ أَنْصَارَا
verses.transcription: halayka yaa man bihi lii qudtta ansaaraa

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ مَطْلَبَتِى قَضَيْتَ لِى أَرَبِى
verses.transcription: lii qudtta matlabatii qadayta lii arabii
mahawta hanniya qablal yawmi aw zaaraa

bayts.text: يَامُكْرِمَ الضَّيْفِ جَارًا كَانَ أَوْزَارَا ۞ يَامَاحِيًا عَنْ خَدِيمٍ قَبْلُ أَوْزَارَا

translations.it.karamati: O tu che onori l'ospite, che fosse vicino o visitatore, o tu che hai cancellato da un servitore, già prima, i pesi (dei peccati),
translations.en.karamati: O you who honour the guest, whether neighbour or visitor, O you who effaced from a servant, already before, the burdens (of sins),
translations.fr.karamati: Ô toi qui honores l'hôte, qu'il soit voisin ou visiteur, ô toi qui as effacé d'un servant, déjà auparavant, les fardeaux (des péchés),

bayts.text: نَادَاكَ فِى الْبَرِّ بَعْدَ الْبَحْرِ خَادِمُكُمْ ۞ وَالْيَوْمَ قُدْتَّ لَهُ بِاللَّهِ مَااخْتَارَا

translations.it.karamati: ti ha chiamato sulla terraferma, dopo il mare, il vostro servitore, e oggi gli hai condotto, per mezzo di Allah, ciò che ha scelto.
translations.en.karamati: your servant called you on land, after the sea, and today you led to him, through Allah, what he chose.
translations.fr.karamati: t'a appelé sur la terre ferme, après la mer, votre servant, et aujourd'hui tu lui as amené, par Allah, ce qu'il a choisi.

bayts.text: أكْرَمْتَهُ بِقِرَى أَمْرٍ وَتَكْرِمَةٍ ۞ فَحَازَ عَنْ جُمْلَةِ الْأَسْوَآءِ أَسْتَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Lo hai onorato con l'ospitalità di una faccenda e di un onore, ed egli ha ottenuto, contro l'insieme dei mali, dei veli.
translations.en.karamati: You honoured him with the hospitality of an affair and an honour, and he obtained, against all evils, veils.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu l'as honoré par l'hospitalité d'une affaire et d'un honneur, et il a obtenu, contre l'ensemble des maux, des voiles.

bayts.text: خَلَّيْتَهُ عَنْ سِوَى الرِّضْوَانِ قَبْلُ كَمَا ۞ حَلَّيْتَهُ بِمُنَى الدَّارَيْنِ مِبْرَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Lo hai liberato già prima da altro che il compiacimento, come lo hai adornato con i desideri delle due Dimore, assai pio.
translations.en.karamati: You freed him already before from all but good pleasure, as you adorned him with the wishes of the two Abodes, most dutiful.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu l'as libéré déjà auparavant de ce qui n'est pas l'agrément, comme tu l'as paré des souhaits des deux Demeures, très pieux.

bayts.text: بِكَ انْتَهَى سَيْرُهُ لِلَّهِ مُرْتَضِيًا ۞ عَنْكُمْ وَقَدْ حَازَ أَنْوَارًا وَأَسْرَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Per mezzo di te è giunto a termine il suo cammino verso Allah, compiaciuto di voi; e ha già ottenuto luci e segreti.
translations.en.karamati: Through you his journey to Allah has reached its end, well pleased with you; and he has already obtained lights and secrets.
translations.fr.karamati: Par toi a pris fin son cheminement vers Allah, satisfait de vous ; et il a déjà obtenu lumières et secrets.

bayts.text: أَمَّنْتَهُ مِنْ شَقَآءٍ فَآئِزًا أَبَدًا ۞ خِلًّا وَحِبًّا لَّكُمْ لَايَدْخُلُ النَّارَا

translations.it.karamati: Lo hai messo al sicuro dalla miseria, trionfante per sempre, intimo e amato per voi: egli non entra nel Fuoco.
translations.en.karamati: You made him safe from misery, triumphant forever, an intimate and a beloved for you: he does not enter the Fire.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu l'as mis à l'abri de la misère, triomphant à jamais, intime et aimé pour vous : il n'entre pas dans le Feu.

bayts.text: نَالَ الْمُنَى مَعْ صَفَا مَا بَعْدَهُ كَدَرٌ ۞ مِنْ مُشْتَرٍ مِّنْهُ عِنْدَ الْبَحْرِ دِينَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Ha conseguito i desideri con una limpidezza dopo la quale non vi è torbidezza, da parte di Colui che ha comprato da lui, presso il mare, un dīnār.
translations.en.karamati: He attained the wishes with a clarity after which there is no turbidity, from Him Who bought from him, by the sea, a dīnār.
translations.fr.karamati: Il a obtenu les souhaits avec une limpidité après laquelle il n'y a pas de trouble, de la part de Celui qui a acheté de lui, près de la mer, un dīnār.

bayts.text: مِنْهُ اشْتَرَى اللَّهُ كَحْ حَيْثُ انْتَحَتْ أَبَدًا ۞ كَمَا لَهُ قَادَ مَا يَهْوَاهُ أَوْطَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Da lui Allah ha comprato (e allontanato) ogni avversario invidioso, ovunque si sia diretto, per sempre, come gli ha condotto ciò che desidera dei bisogni.
translations.en.karamati: From him Allah has bought (and removed) every envious adversary, wherever he turned, forever, as He led to him what he desires of needs.
translations.fr.karamati: De lui Allah a acheté (et éloigné) tout adversaire envieux, partout où il s'est dirigé, à jamais, comme Il lui a amené ce qu'il désire des besoins.

bayts.text: وَلَّى اللَّعِينُ بِيَأْسٍ مِّنْهُ مُنْصَرِفًا ۞ وَكُلُّ مَا فِيهِ ضُرٌّ دَبَّ أَوْطَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Il Maledetto si è volto indietro disperando di lui, allontanandosi, e tutto ciò in cui vi è danno si è insinuato altrove.
translations.en.karamati: The Accursed turned back, despairing of him, going away, and all wherein is harm has crept elsewhere.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Maudit a tourné le dos désespérant de lui, s'éloignant, et tout ce en quoi il y a dommage s'est insinué ailleurs.

bayts.text: لِغَيْرِهِ يَنْتَحِى إِبْلِيسُ فِى أَبَدٍ ۞ كَفَاهُ رَبُّكَ تَخْمِينًا وَأَكْدَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Verso altri che lui si dirige Iblīs, per sempre: gli ha risparmiato il tuo Signore congetture e torbidezze.
translations.en.karamati: Toward others than him Iblīs makes, forever: your Lord has spared him conjectures and turbidities.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers d'autres que lui se dirige Iblīs, à jamais : ton Seigneur lui a épargné conjectures et troubles.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ النَّبِىُّ الرَّسُولُ الْمُصْطَفَى عَلَمًا ۞ صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ الَّذِى التَّفْضِيلُ قَدْ دَّارَا

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Profeta, l'Inviato, il Prescelto, il vessillo: ti benedica Colui la cui preferenza (per te) è già girata (attorno a te).
translations.en.karamati: You are the Prophet, the Messenger, the Chosen, the banner: may He bless you Whose preference (for you) has already circled (around you).
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Prophète, l'Envoyé, l'Élu, l'étendard : que te bénisse Celui dont la préférence (pour toi) a déjà tourné (autour de toi).

bayts.text: إِنِّى لَجَارُكَ يَاخَيْرَ الْوَرَى أَبَدًا ۞ عَلَيْكَ سَلَّمَ مَنْ كُلِّى لَهُ صَارَا

translations.it.karamati: In verità io sono il tuo vicino, o migliore del creato, per sempre: ti dia pace Colui al Quale tutto me è divenuto (proprio).
translations.en.karamati: Truly I am your neighbour, O best of creation, forever: may He grant you peace to Whom all of me has come to belong.
translations.fr.karamati: En vérité je suis ton voisin, ô meilleur de la création, à jamais : que t'accorde la paix Celui à Qui tout mon être est devenu (propre).

bayts.text: صَلَّى وَسَلَّمَ بَاقٍ لَّا شَرِيكَ لَهُ ۞ عَلَيْكَ يَامَنْ بِهِ لِى قُدْتَّ أَنْصَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Ti benedica e ti doni pace un Permanente che non ha associato, o tu per mezzo del quale mi hai condotto dei soccorritori.
translations.en.karamati: May an Everlasting One with no partner bless you and grant you peace, O you through whom He led helpers to me.
translations.fr.karamati: Que te bénisse et t'accorde la paix un Permanent qui n'a pas d'associé, ô toi par qui Tu m'as amené des secoureurs.

bayts.text: لِى قُدْتَّ مَطْلَبَتِى قَضَيْتَ لِى أَرَبِى ۞ مَحَوْتَ عَنِّىَ قَبْلَ الْيَوْمِ أَوْزَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai condotto la mia richiesta, hai soddisfatto il mio bisogno, hai cancellato da me, prima di oggi, i pesi (dei peccati).
translations.en.karamati: You led my request to me, you met my need, you effaced from me, before today, the burdens (of sins).
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as amené ma demande, tu as satisfait mon besoin, tu as effacé de moi, avant aujourd'hui, les fardeaux (des péchés).
